title: Postgres Write Lock Chaos Experiment
description: When an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE (write) lock is acquired on the booking_details table for an extended duration, all concurrent INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE operations on the table are blocked. As a result, the booking-service fails to persist booking details, leading to 5xx errors on booking-related APIs. Additionally the backend service which is gets failed during the view detail  as Insert query could not get succeeded is  hotel-booking-post-processing-service-1.
